biography.value:
Description

A rampaging wolf-like monster with two horns jutting from its back. It sometimes breathes fire. - Imban

Defense

AC 22, touch 11, flat-footed 20 (+2 Dex, +11 natural, -1 size)

hp 114 [156] (12d8+60)

Fort +13, Ref +9, Will +8

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 2 claws +15 (1d6+7), gore +16 (1d8+7)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Berserk Pounce, Fire Breath (20-ft. cone, 7d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 20 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Greater Berserk, Impale

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 15, Con 18, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +9; CMB +17 (+19 overrun); CMD 29 (31 vs. overrun, 33 vs. trip)

Feats Charge Through, Improved Overrun, Iron Will, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Gore)

Skills Perception +19

Ecology

Environment deserts, plains

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure none

GM note: Generic prose says most nashorns get 45 temporary HP; this 12-HD specimen receives 36.

A berserk nashorn can make a full attack at the end of its charge.

effect: While berserk, full attack at the end of a charge.

description.value: A nashorn that takes damage in combat goes berserk on its next turn, attacking madly until either it or its opponent is dead. It gains a +3 bonus on melee attack rolls, melee damage rolls, and Will saving throws but takes a -2 penalty to its Armor Class. It also gains 3 temporary hit points per Hit Die, which is 45 temporary hit points for most nashorns. In addition, the nashorn gains immunity to fear and the pounce ability. The nashorn cannot end its berserk state voluntarily.
When charging, a nashorn deals double damage with its gore attack.

effect: Charge only. Double gore damage; -2 AC until next turn.

description.value: On the turn after taking damage. Fear immunity and pounce; gain 36 temporary HP (3 per HD) once on entry. Cannot end until it or its opponent dies.
